lip_sync_strategy.mouth_closed: All I2V prompts: mouth stays naturally closed. No speaking performance. No 'small mouth motion allowed'.

provider_choice: Higgsfield Kling 3.0 Pro I2V is the existing photoreal identity path. Sound=off so audio can be regenerated alone. 5s vs 10s price must come from live /estimate, not a 2× assumption.
